endpoint.recipe: exact EndpointOverride only; no endpoint guessed from model/service
endpoint.scope: exact caller project; explicit location if supplied

request.mapping: multipart model/audio file/optional language/explicit json or verbose_json; explicit bounded MaxAudioBytes; protected filename/audio, no file system access
excluded_variants: text/srt/vtt/diarized formats and other OpenAI options not confirmed by selected first-party examples
Whole provider inventory and deployment-specific availability remain unverified
request.upload: caller-protected memory payload copied only through bounded multipart writer; no SDK file open; TransferTimeout/context; oversized audio rejected NotSent before credentials or HTTP

response.completeness: bounded structured response; embedding/image count mismatch returns incomplete with accepted receipt and typed prefix; no resource/task/ref adoption
response.usage: exact typed counters, discriminated transcription duration/tokens, no absent-as-zero or billing/readiness inference
response.refs: completion/model IDs remain protected metadata; no resource/task ref or wait
response.formats: json text with typed optional usage; verbose_json requires language/duration and typed protected segments/word/token IDs

errors.mapping: core HTTP mapping; raw messages/body discarded; accepted malformed/body-limit error retains Receipt

retry: all model POST mutations: no automatic replay, no idempotency assumptions
